data.title: Education Minister Visits Saudi Students Exhibition in Washington, Reviews Academic Projects and Research Initiatives
data.content:
Washington, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Minister of Education Yousef Al-Benyan visited an exhibition for Saudi students organized in Washington by the Saudi Arabia Cultural Mission to USA, as part of his official visit to the country.
    During his tour, the minister reviewed several academic and research projects presented by Saudi students enrolled in American universities and educational institutions, listening to their explanations regarding their projects, fields of specialization, areas of interest, and the knowledge and experience gained throughout their educational journey.
    He also met with several students and emphasized the importance of leveraging the scholarship experience to develop national capabilities and align academic and research expertise with national priorities.
    -- SPA
12:29 Local Time 09:29 GMT
